authorization: 2026-10-19 user: Approve the R1964 plan: opt-in step with provisional GPR YALI1F03452g or YALI1E06616g, plus the MNXR198271/Rhea 17921/EC 1.1.1.11 annotation fix, and the 5 LPs.

YALI1E06616g.identity: NCBI Gene 2912324 (YALI1_E06616g, old tag YALI2_E00126g) encodes XP_503594.1 (291 aa), identical in sequence to UniProt Q6C6W8 (YALI0_E05643g, CLIB122); compared 2026-10-19. No gene name is verified: NCBI 'uncharacterized protein', KEGG RefSeq-derived 'Sorbose reductase sou1' with no KO; 'YlAraDH2' is the name used by Wang et al. 2020.

reviewer: Claude Code session (delegated read-only review, 2026-10-19); decision by the user

evidence.claim: Wang et al. 2020 (doi:10.1186/s13068-020-01815-8) Table 2: purified YlAraDH1 (YALI0F02211g, = YALI1F03452g) and YlAraDH2 (YALI0E05643g, = YALI1E06616g), NAD(H)-dependent, reduce D-xylulose with NADH (1.4 and 2.2 U/mg, pH 6.0; product named arabitol) and oxidize D-arabitol with NAD+ (5.3 and 6.3 U/mg, pH 8.0; product named D-xylulose).
evidence.scope: In vitro, His-tagged protein from E. coli, >95 % pure; activity followed at 340 nm only, so products were assigned, not identified; no host-background control described; no deletion phenotype on 300 g/L glucose.

evidence.claim: YALI1_E06616g (GeneID 2912324) encodes XP_503594.1; its sequence equals UniProt Q6C6W8 (YALI0_E05643g); Wang et al. primer termini MSNSAKAAV / IDGGYTII* match.
evidence.scope: Identity only; the CGMCC7326 clone's internal sequence was not compared.

evidence.claim: MNXref 4.5 (local reac_prop.tsv/reac_xref.tsv): MNXR198271 = D-arabinitol + NAD(+) = D-xylulose (MNXM1371292, the model's m1015) + NADH + H(+), EC 1.1.1.11, xrefs Rhea 17921-17924, BiGG/VMH ABTDG, MetaCyc D-ARABINITOL-4-DEHYDROGENASE-RXN. The replaced MNXR154181 (BiGG/VMH ABTD1) uses L-xylulose (MNXM1371095).
evidence.tier: verified in the local MNXref 4.5 tables; the URL itself was not opened

evidence.claim: R05604 D-arabinitol:NAD 4-oxidoreductase, C01904 + C00003 <=> C00310 + C00004 + C00080, EC 1.1.1.11.
evidence.scope: MNXref 4.5 maps R05604 to MNXR198270, which differs from MNXR198271 only in using alpha-D-xylulofuranose.

evidence.claim: D-arabinitol + NAD(+) = D-xylulose + NADH + H(+); EC 1.1.1.11.
Hallborn et al. 1995: the homologous Pichia stipitis SDR D-arabinitol dehydrogenase yields D-ribulose from D-arabinitol (EC 1.1.1.250 regiochemistry).
evidence.scope: Related organism; evidence against the C-4 reading for the homolog, kept as a limit.

notes.gpr_evidence_basis: In vitro activity of the purified Y. lipolytica proteins (Wang et al. 2020, doi:10.1186/s13068-020-01815-8, Table 2): NADH-linked D-xylulose reduction and NAD+-linked D-arabitol oxidation; reaction products assigned from a 340 nm NAD(P)H assay, not identified
notes.r1964_gene_function: YALI1F03452g (= YALI0F02211g, called YlAraDH1 in Wang 2020) and YALI1E06616g (= YALI0E05643g, called YlAraDH2); no verified gene names; NAD(H)-dependent short-chain polyol dehydrogenases also active on mannitol, D-sorbitol and xylitol in vitro; no deletion phenotype on glucose; experimental product identification required.
notes.r1964_regiochemistry_limit: Whether these enzymes oxidize D-arabinitol at C-4 (D-xylulose, this reaction, EC 1.1.1.11) or at C-2 (D-ribulose, EC 1.1.1.250, the homology label on YALI1F03452g and R2190) is not settled: D-ribulose was never tested; a stereochemical reading of the measured substrate pattern favours C-4 (inferred); the 42 % identical fungal homologs form D-ribulose.
notes.r1964_previous_annotation: bigg.reaction/vmhreaction ABTD1, metanetx.reaction MNXR154181 (L-arabinitol 4-dehydrogenase record pairing D-arabinitol with L-xylulose); replaced because m1015 is D-xylulose (MNXM1371292).
notes.r1964_gpr_authorization: User authorized the opt-in provisional GPR YALI1F03452g or YALI1E06616g and the D-xylulose cross-references on 2026-10-19 (model/reports/r1964_gpr_20261019).
